description: Defines the GLES1Renderer class which emulates GLES1 rendering operations on top of a GLES3 context, including shader compilation, program linking, uniform setting, and texture rendering.

classes.name: GLES1Renderer
classes.description: A final class implementing GLES1 emulation rendering operations, managing shader programs, uniforms, and rendering states.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the renderer is destroyed.

methods.name: prepareForDraw
methods.description: Prepares the renderer for drawing with specified mode, context, and state.

methods.name: drawTexture
methods.description: Renders a texture at specified position and size.
